limits: No full stack/priority and replacement rules, triggered abilities, token/mass-zone operations, mana optimizer or all-land legality
No actual shuffling/searching/drawing from card effects, except explicitly tested state operations
No turn-skipping, card draw probability inference from these four samples, actual opening-hand keep policy or game win rates
No simulated casting or card-effect resolution integrated from prior Abaddon interpreter in this cycle
Every commander still requires independent identity and candidate analyses, Phase B experiments, critic/reconciliation, I/J and user reviews

policies.draws: Opening 7 cards, then exactly four further draws without skips (synthetic sampling of access, not real Commander turns)
policies.interaction: no actions by simulated opponents; no sampling opponent distribution
policies.land_plays: only basic lands with unconditional untapped entry; nonbasic lands fail closed until Oracle ETB decisions are specified
policies.mana_preflight: Use pip-matching only for static printed costs where possible; never model cost increases, cost reductions, additional costs, alt/free costs, priority triggers or effects
policies.unsupported: explicit blocked outcome with no mutation
